preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output sequence must have exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output sequence must be integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output sequence must be between 1 and n inclusive.
The output sequence must be lexicographically maximum.
